summary: Frontend-only verification of the MOODFOOD Welcome-screen brand logo fix. Verified DOM at 375x667 and 390x844: brand text equals exactly 'MOODFOOD' (no ellipsis, no truncation), rendered on a single line (height=38px for fontSize=31px), scrollWidth==clientWidth (327 @375, 342 @390) so there is no horizontal overflow, and tagline 'When feelings need feeding' does not overlap the brand. Registration flow (input-name/input-email/input-password -> auth-submit) succeeded and navigated into the tabs where the mood grid is visible. All three requested checks pass.

issues: Brand text starts at y=240 while hero image spans y=0-260 (body marginTop:-20). The LinearGradient fades to background at 100% (y=260), so at y=240 (~92%) some residual hero pixels are visible behind the 'MOODFOOD' letters, causing a very slight visual overlap with the hero. Text itself is fully rendered and readable; this is a design/gradient nuance, not a truncation or wrap. If a cleaner look is desired, either raise the gradient stop to ~0.7 or reduce body marginTop to 0.

action_items: No fix required for the reported bug. Brand renders 'MOODFOOD' fully on one line at both 375px and 390px viewports and registration still works.
Optional polish: adjust LinearGradient locations from [0.35,1] to e.g. [0.35,0.85] or remove body marginTop:-20 to eliminate the faint hero bleed behind the brand text.
critical_code_review_comments: welcome.tsx line 74: numberOfLines={1} paired with fontSize:31 fits 'MOODFOOD' within (screenWidth - 48px horizontal padding) at both 375px and 390px viewports (measured widths 327 and 342). Safe.

Console warnings observed (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Present in shared UI components, not welcome.tsx.
seed_data_creation: Registered a fresh user test+<timestamp>@example.com / Test1234 for the end-to-end flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brand logo bug is resolved. DOM assertions confirm textContent='MOODFOOD', single line, no overflow, at 375 and 390 wide. If revisited, check computed style whiteSpace='nowrap', textOverflow='ellipsis', scrollWidth<=clientWidth, and bounding-box height < 60 to catch regressions.
rca_of_issue: Prior regressions: (1) with a larger fontSize the word wrapped to two lines; (2) with adjustsFontSizeToFit + numberOfLines={1} on RN web, adjustsFontSizeToFit is a no-op so the still-too-large text got ellipsis-truncated to 'MOODFO...'. Current fix (fontSize:31, letterSpacing:0, numberOfLines:1, no adjustsFontSizeToFit) makes the intrinsic text width (327/342) fit inside the available 327/342 px column, so ellipsis never activates and single-line is preserved.
